options.label: Pill chips + attempts grid (what is built now)
options.notes: Status as a toned pill chip (building, fixing, landing, landed, complete, escalated); the Attempts tab is a DataGrid, newest first: #, failure, strategy, model, account, result chip, what happened. Densest; reads like the Steps grid next to it.

options.label: Dot + word, attempts as a timeline
options.notes: Status as a coloured dot and its word (quieter in long tables); the Attempts tab is a vertical timeline, one entry per try with its result colour. Easiest to read on the phone.

options.label: Icon chips, attempts grouped by failure
options.notes: Status chip with an icon per status; attempts grouped under each failure (CI red, crashed …), with the ladder still to try under them. Shows best what was tried for which problem.
